headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 14, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Keider Montero earning the win. In other news, the Cincinnati Reds rallied past the Chicago White Sox 9-8, led by Eugenio Suárez's home run and 4 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Miami Marlins 13-1, with Rafael Flores Jr. leading the charge with 2 home runs and 6 RBIs.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Matt Chapman being transferred to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. Trevor McDonald also joins him on the 60-day list with a right elbow strain. Garrett Whitlock has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right elbow inflammation. James Outman has been placed on the 7-day injured list with a concussion, while Riley Greene is out with a right hamstring strain. Endy Rodríguez has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left hip inflammation. Jake Bloss has been placed on the 60-day injured list, and Kyle Karros is out with a concussion.

The Baltimore Orioles have made a trade, acquiring Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox. The Kansas City Royals have also made a trade, acquiring Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 3-0 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Keider Montero earning the win. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past White Sox 9-8**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a thrilling 9-8 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. Tejay Antone earned the win with a strong relief appearance, striking out 3 batters in 1 inning of work.

top_news.title: **Pirates Rout Marlins 13-1 in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 13-1 victory over the Miami Marlins, behind a standout performance from their offense and pitching staff. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' charge with 2 home runs and 6 RBIs, while Braxton Ashcraft pitched 9 strong innings, striking out 10 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Down Yankees in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Matt Chapman Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants third baseman Matt Chapman has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal with the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
